authority: Only S0 launches paid/scientific runs, supplies public facts/tools and qualification, and binds integrated source/cache/evaluator identities. B only projects and checks serialization.

cache.key: full versioned input, model/evaluator/source hashes, not task ID or trajectory name
cache.overlays: independent per arm and replicate; no cross-arm adaptive result sharing
cache.report: separate task-level and run-level outcomes; preserve failures, UNKNOWN, no-update and incurred usage
cache.snapshot: S0 freezes one common initial cache per task before first arm

conditions.role: Coarse information ablation; task, legal space, assumptions and units remain common
Strong complete static facts, including all available records, state laws, waveforms, traces and applicability limits
Unabridged public raw records; no additional physics withheld from rich-static; equality of their fact sets is an admissible negative control
Same complete facts plus executable response; response/check/confirmation share two distinct design exposures
Generic source acquisition and bounded model-proposed observation pipeline; target relation and field relevance are not supplied

e4.unit: one task/arm/replicate; count separately from E5 information comparison

group_budget.accounting_scope: One total per condition/task/replicate, including model calls, acquisition, proposal, qualification, consumer use and confirmation; no E5 extra allocation. Cache hits consume exposure and tool/time allowance; duplicate confirmation creates no free additional D.

pilot.formal_repetitions_rule: After two pilot replicates, once choose 2 if outcomes/designs stable across repeats, else 3; no outcome-dependent stopping afterward.

preregistration.claim_boundary: Public development pilot and finite controlled digital BF comparison, with task-level and run-level separation. Not hardware qualification, original failed-episode success, transfer or RSI.
preregistration.falsifier: Equal-information contrast silently changes facts/tools, baseline weakened, model given target expression, or derived case passed off as hardware evidence.
preregistration.hypothesis: Richer or executable BF information has mechanism-dependent value beyond average-energy and complete-static baselines.
negative_controls: malformed syntax before valid proposal cap
postdelivery reset is not pending state retention
changed input cannot reuse stale trajectory
preregistration.paper_claim: Richer or executable BF information has mechanism-dependent value beyond average-energy and complete-static baselines.
schema_changes: additive phase3 conditions, corrected ordered-state evaluator, shared-cache snapshot/isolated overlays, prospective v2 host, matched-total-budget receipts
preregistration.stop_condition: Frozen scientific drift, unknown usage/model identity, cost/time/request/storage cap, hidden label leakage, changed fixed semantics or unusable source. Preserve every request/failure/no-update.

tasks.mechanism: Existing static-sufficient pulse control; saved exact-input outputs reused
Cold-start/transient/reset feedback with volatile pending state
Pending event captured before reset, retained across reset and first delivered after reset; ordered evidence required, not the legacy Boolean label
Energy arrival before and after a query, cold-start readiness, volatile query capture, earliest-TX scheduling and a fixed causal reply deadline; no additional physical relation is supplied.

tool_roles.design: Host check/submit/no-update contract; legal D only, at most two distinct exposures
tool_roles.model_response: Executable response to legal D; shares design cap and total wall/request budget with design checks
tool_roles.observation: Generic sources/acquire/propose/qualify/consume/confirm pipeline under the same total budget; maps to S0's frozen host, no separate allowance
